bio: Mr. Sawan is Pratibha's fiancé and future husband. She affectionately calls him Mr. Kichi Kichi, Bebo, Baby, Shona, her cutie, her chikna man, her Kurkure, and Sabu Kichi. Pratibha describes him as handsome, intelligent, affectionate, observant, playful, and mischievous. Although their relationship began through an arranged marriage process, she feels that it has developed like a love marriage. Their relationship is filled with initial shyness, growing emotional intimacy, thoughtful gestures, romantic moments, playful teasing, and long conversations. Pratibha feels that Sawan has brought out a talkative and expressive side of her that she did not expect to reveal to anyone else. She treasures his efforts, particularly his letters, flowers, snacks, and chocolates. She feels blessed to have him as her future husband and appreciates his encouragement to study, learn new skills, and become independent. She hopes their love and affection will continue throughout their married life.

family_planning_discussion.pratibha_stated_preference: Pratibha wants two children: a boy who resembles Sawan and a girl who inherits his cleverness and intelligence.

family_planning_discussion.guidance: Treat this as a personal anecdote and not as a confirmed family-planning agreement or a commitment by either partner.

relationship_context.relationship_to_couple: Sawan is Pratibha's fiancé and future husband. The profile's memories and relationship descriptions are primarily narrated from Pratibha's perspective.
relationship_context.closeness: Very close, romantic, and deeply affectionate, according to Pratibha.

shared_experiences.details: Their first meeting took place through an arranged marriage process. Pratibha was extremely shy and could not maintain eye contact with Sawan, not even for a fraction of a second. She did not fully understand why she felt so shy, but she felt that both her heart and mind were saying yes to him.
shared_experiences.emotional_significance: The beginning of a relationship that felt unexpectedly natural and emotionally meaningful to Pratibha.

shared_experiences.event: Watching Sawan through the CCTV camera
shared_experiences.details: During Sawan's first visit, Pratibha and her sisters watched him through the CCTV camera and exchanged comments about how he kept smiling. His gentle smile seemed to stay on his face, and they found it sweet and cute.
shared_experiences.emotional_significance: An early, playful memory of Pratibha noticing Sawan's smile and feeling attracted to him.

shared_experiences.details: When Sawan and Pratibha were alone together in a room, they talked without looking directly at each other because they were both shy.
shared_experiences.emotional_significance: A sweet reminder of their initial nervousness and unfamiliarity with their new relationship.

shared_experiences.details: When leaving the room, Sawan carried the cup and tray out himself even though Pratibha asked him not to. After everyone left, Pratibha was scolded about the incident. The identity of the person who scolded her was not specified.
shared_experiences.emotional_significance: A small but memorable incident from their first meeting.

shared_experiences.details: While eating together at the dining table, Sawan placed the plate of salad close to Pratibha.
shared_experiences.emotional_significance: Pratibha remembers the small gesture as part of the thoughtful details that made their first meeting special.

shared_experiences.details: Before leaving, Sawan gave Pratibha chocolates and asked her sister to call her downstairs. He then waved goodbye to her. Pratibha had not expected this gesture but liked it.
shared_experiences.emotional_significance: An unexpected, charming goodbye that remained fresh in Pratibha's memory.

shared_experiences.event: Moving from text messages to long phone calls
shared_experiences.details: Sawan and Pratibha began talking through text messages and eventually moved to phone calls. Their conversations became so long that Pratibha describes them as never-ending.
shared_experiences.emotional_significance: Their communication grew naturally, and Pratibha discovered that she could talk much more openly with Sawan than she had expected to talk with anyone.

shared_experiences.details: Sawan sent Pratibha flowers, snacks, and chocolates. He also wrote letters to her. His first letter is particularly precious to her, and she repeatedly emphasizes how deeply his efforts touch her heart.
shared_experiences.emotional_significance: These gestures make Pratibha feel loved and valued. She treasures his efforts and says she cannot ignore him because she loves the way he is.

shared_experiences.details: Their second meeting took place at their engagement. Pratibha remembers the occasion as wonderful, particularly the way Sawan eagerly wanted to catch a glimpse of her. She had not imagined that someone would love her so much.
shared_experiences.emotional_significance: The engagement felt dreamlike to Pratibha. She hopes that their love will last forever and says she cannot imagine her life without him.

shared_experiences.details: During their third meeting, Sawan surprised Pratibha by entering her room unexpectedly. She had a towel wrapped around her head, covering her wet hair, and felt embarrassed by the timing of his arrival. Seeing him suddenly brought up so many mixed emotions that she struggled to find words or express herself. She became overwhelmed and tears rolled down her eyes.
shared_experiences.emotional_significance: An unexpected, emotionally intense surprise that remains vivid in Pratibha's memory.

shared_experiences.details: While they were in a movie hall, Sawan held Pratibha's hand for the first time. Her heart started racing, and she experienced goosebumps. His touch tickled her, and she felt he was deliberately doing it to tease her. Although she felt annoyed with him, part of her enjoyed the moment too.
shared_experiences.emotional_significance: A new and magical experience of romantic closeness that Pratibha had never expected to experience in this way.

shared_experiences.event: The cheek kiss in the lift
shared_experiences.details: While they were in a lift, Sawan bent his face toward Pratibha and suddenly asked her for a kiss on his cheek. She quickly kissed one of his cheeks.
shared_experiences.emotional_significance: A spontaneous, playful, and affectionate memory.

shared_experiences.time: The day after the lift incident
shared_experiences.details: Sawan and Pratibha visited a temple together and later had brunch.
shared_experiences.emotional_significance: Another cherished part of their time together during the September visit.

shared_experiences.event: Cheek kisses and a hug on the terrace
shared_experiences.details: In the evening, Pratibha had a moment alone with Sawan on the terrace at her home. She kissed his cheek and began to leave, but he asked her to stop and playfully insisted on two more kisses on his cheeks. They then hugged for approximately three to four seconds. Pratibha had wanted that hug very much but felt so overwhelmed that she cannot clearly recall the moment. What she remembers is that his embrace was tight.
shared_experiences.emotional_significance: An intensely cherished moment of affection. Pratibha wishes she could relive it and remember every detail more clearly.

shared_experiences.time: End of the third meeting in September
shared_experiences.details: Pratibha and others accompanied Sawan to the station. During the car journey, Sawan teased her, and she enjoyed their playful interaction.
shared_experiences.emotional_significance: A fond ending to a meeting filled with new romantic experiences and affectionate memories.
